label: Processing only (no storage)
description: Data is held only in memory for the duration of a request and is never written to durable storage.

label: Storage < 48 hours
description: Data is persisted but deleted within 48 hours. Typically caches, short-lived audit buffers, or transient queues.

label: Storage ≥ 48 hours
description: Data is persisted for 48 hours or longer. Document the retention period and deletion behavior for the data and applicable obligations. This modeling bucket does not define a legal retention limit.
